# Queenan Law

> A Texas-based personal injury law firm specializing in accident claims, medical malpractice, and business litigation across Dallas, Arlington, Houston, and surrounding areas.

Queenan Law, PC is led by founding attorney M. Kevin Queenan and serves clients throughout Texas with offices in multiple cities. The firm focuses on representing injured individuals in vehicle accidents, transportation incidents, and medical negligence cases.
